AMZN.zacks_measure: GAAP diluted EPS incl. equity marks in Q3-26, ex the Anthropic stake gains in Q1/Q2-26

APP.zacks_measure: GAAP diluted EPS (AppLovin reports no non-GAAP EPS)

AVGO.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS less stock comp (unconfirmed detail: Zacks sits +0.05 to +0.08 above non-GAAP less SBC at the 16% non-GAAP rate on non-GAAP shares)

BKNG.zacks_measure: company adjusted EPS (excludes the FTC matter, investment marks and other non-recurring items; stock comp not excluded)

COHR.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS less stock comp after tax

CRDO.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS less stock comp

DY.zacks_measure: company Non-GAAP Adjusted EPS (GAAP before intangible amortization, net of tax; stock comp NOT excluded)

GOOGL.zacks_measure: GAAP diluted EPS incl. equity-security marks

INTC.restated: reported quarters restated on the forecast basis: the quarter build subtracts sbc_c from EBIT but the reported rows are before stock comp (not the filings' operating income), so EBIT - SBC (2026-03 1,668-621, 2026-06 2,468-687, 2026-09 3,097-586)
INTC.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS less Intel's own share-based compensation per-share line

KEYS.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS less stock comp after tax

META.zacks_measure: GAAP diluted EPS excluding one-time items Meta itself calls out (Q3-26 $9.89B state AG charge, $3.57/sh; Q1-26 and Q3-25 one-time tax items)

MOD.zacks_measure: company adjusted EPS, whole company (Performance Technologies until the 2026-10-01 spin)

NFLX.zacks_measure: GAAP diluted EPS ex one-off items (Netflix reports no non-GAAP EPS; Q1-26 left out the $2.7B one-off other income)

NVDA.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS (NVIDIA includes stock comp in non-GAAP from Q1 FY27; excludes equity-security gains, acquisition costs, legal settlement, other)

SNOW.zacks_measure: company non-GAAP EPS less stock comp net of the tax effect the company books on it (= GAAP plus after-tax amortization, acquisition and debt-cost items), on GAAP basic shares while a loss
